_comment: RK solution team RBAC baseline. Apply with scripts/apply-rbac.py (idempotent:
roles are created or updated to match this file; bindings are created if missing).
Future org changes are config edits here, e.g.:
- new chip solution 'aw': copy this file to tenant-bindings.aw.json, rename
role to aw-developer, bind at scope 'aw/*' (after that namespace exists).
- split Linux/Android teams: add role rk-linux-developer bound to
'rk/Linux/*' (or 'label:os=linux') for group rk-linux-team, and narrow the
existing binding's scope via the Web UI (Roles page) or DELETE /role-bindings/{id}.
Permissions vocabulary: read, push, submit, abandon, comment, editTopicName,

groups.name: rk-team
groups.description: RK solution team (member container for future per-team bindings)

roles.name: rk-developer
roles.description: read/push/review/submit across the whole rk/ namespace tree
